candidates: Proofread CHANGELOG.md entries for spelling errors before merging; these entries are user-facing release notes and typos (e.g. a truncated word like 'websocke') should be caught before the PR lands.

When calling `presets.apply('core')` in builder-manager or core-server code, the return value is a full `CoreConfig` object; always navigate to the correct nested property path on that result (e.g. `coreOptions.channelOptions.wsToken`) rather than reading a property as if it were at the top level of the returned object.

In `renderHTML` (`code/builders/builder-manager/src/utils/template.ts`), every value added to the `globals` map must be wrapped with `JSON.stringify()` before assignment. The EJS template renders globals as bare JavaScript variable initializers via `<%- (globals[varName]) %>`, so assigning a raw object will produce the string `[object Object]` at runtime instead of valid JSON. New entries added to `globals` must follow the same `JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)` pattern used by all existing entries.
